label: Cluster reassessment of causal perfection transfer, reception and fullness under current standards
summary: Issue #1751 slice 2 reassessment of the 18 open GOD_4-route premises whose attempts cite docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md, plus neighbours f8ba2429, b26c10a0, 5a4afaa5 and 8176a284. It reread the whole note, the four citing attempts (74008d2a, 3de52780, round2 perfection primacy, subsistent-infinity reception audit), the further attempts on these targets and the q44 note's warrant sections. Every target got dossier and brief retrieval. The cluster splits into four sub-bundles: reception to own being, participation coverage and source supply, fullness and degree, and causal transfer. For each central premise the record states the strongest positive warrant, the direct or primitive option and the shared dependencies. Eleven recorded objection or rival records are classified under the 2026-11-12 standard. Kept (2): the united-soul objection against the broad scope of own-essence reception 6dfe01ab, which never reaches the identity-bearer instances that routes consume; and cross-reception against neighbour 7030af77. The conservationist secondary-only table is restated: it is the earlier section's retained non-entailment fact, and the earlier blocker requiring an independent defense of universal transfer stands. The particular-cause worry about 10cd24ed is no substantive objection identified, matching 3de52780's own audit and its unweighted q.104 heavenly-body lead. Countermodels and omission controls are restated as facts about stated interpretations. The natural-source alternative is restated as a comparison at matching scope that is relevant to naming. The calibration gap and the purity cost are restated as an open bridge and a checked scope cost. Old rival-exhaustion and route-cost framing is replaced. The judgment: the source-scoped participation core is coherent and has moderate prima facie warrant. Universal-scope transfer b26c10a0 is conditional on the open, unassessed 5e281daf, 2f6b9eff and 791fa216 plus a prima facie concurrence option that needs the open pre-naming source identification. Nonuniversal transfer 10cd24ed has no positive warrant and no substantive objection. No theorem, Challenge, claim, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared. The first draft's reweighting of the conservationist rival and its moderate grade for b26c10a0 were withdrawn after independent semantic challenge, not declared.
blocker: Next discriminating test: audit the 43 non-cycle consumers of f8ba2429 for whether they need nonuniversal scope or can consume b26c10a0. Then read q.45 a.5 and decide the c3c01e92 bridge, which fixes whether 10cd24ed is vacuous or a contentful premise whose warrant must be sought (q.115 a.4 lead). Reopen the fd2c8710/9eaa3b6e calibration only with a substantive eminent mode or intensity account on the same source.

current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed reception, OwnBeing, limitation, actual-CIn and degree dictionaries, the source-scoped core (represented identity, unreceived esse, OwnBeing, nonlimitation and infinity, participation coverage, actual esse-cause composition, identity-source ascent) is a coherent participation account. It has moderate prima facie warrant and conditionally reaches fixed-esse maximal causality. It does not settle its primitives, the q3 degree calibration, numerical unity or GOD_4 naming. Universal-scope transfer b26c10a0 is conditional on the open, unassessed analyst premises 5e281daf, 2f6b9eff and 791fa216, plus a prima facie participation and concurrence option. That option needs the open pre-naming identification of the source with the subsistent first agent, on pain of circularity; its standing is unchanged from the earlier record. Nonuniversal transfer 10cd24ed has no positive warrant on file and no substantive objection identified; it is vacuous if only a universal cause causes esse. Routes should consume b26c10a0 where universal scope suffices. Kept objections: 2 (united soul against broad 6dfe01ab; cross-reception against neighbour 7030af77). Countermodels are restated as facts about interpretations. The natural fundamental source remains a live alternative under identical restrictions; nothing is established or defeated.

current_assessment.supersedes: As the current-state summary for these statements only, it supersedes four things. First, reading the #shared-background-tests-and-surviving-rival section's 'surviving substantive rival' (and 'Therefore existence dependence plus possession of perfections does not entail causal responsibility under that background' in 74008d2a) as weight against transfer. Its non-entailment finding and the 74008d2a blocker are retained unchanged. The same section's route-cost and 'zero philosophical premise discharge' accounting is also superseded. Second, 3de52780's framing of 10cd24ed as a new bare leaf whose vacuity is undecided is restated; its own objection audit and unweighted leads are retained. Third, f3722322's 'stating claims leave route cost unchanged' blocker framing as applied to 14325c83 and 6dfe01ab. Fourth, the 2026-11-17 note sections' 'awaits fresh independent semantic challenge' handoff wording. All earlier substantive findings, controls, source boundaries and next tests remain in the note under their own headings.
